title: Microsoft Edge: apply pending updates when the browser is idle
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned idle-restart change from today's documented relaunch policies. The existing controls and roadmap details are supported; a minor clarification should flag Microsoft's conflicting descriptions of the RelaunchNotification numeric values.

claims.claim: Group Policy exposes RelaunchNotification under (Computer Configuration or User Configuration) > Policies > Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Relaunch > Notify a user that a browser restart is recommended or required for pending updates.
claims.quote:
GP name: Notify a user that a browser restart is recommended or required for pending updates
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Relaunch

claims.claim: RelaunchNotification is a REG_DWORD registry value under SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, with 1 meaning Recommended and 2 meaning Required.
claims.quote:
Recommended (1) = Recommended - Show a recurring prompt to the user indicating that a restart is recommended
Required (2) = Required - Show a recurring prompt to the user indicating that a restart is required
claims.fix: Keep the cited RelaunchNotification mapping. Add this qualification and source: 'The RelaunchFastIfOutdated reference inconsistently calls RelaunchNotification value 1 Required, while the RelaunchNotification reference maps 1 to Recommended and 2 to Required.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/relaunchfastifoutdated, which says: "If the RelaunchNotification policy is set to 1 ('Required'), a browser relaunch is forced at the end of the period."

claims.where: controls[0].governs; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The existing RelaunchNotification policy governs notifying users or requiring a restart to apply a pending update.
claims.quote: Notify a user that a browser restart is recommended or required for pending updates

claims.claim: The deployed RelaunchNotification policy applies to its targeted users or computers rather than inherently to the entire tenant.
claims.quote: You can scope policy settings to either the Computer Configuration or User Configuration by selecting the appropriate node as described below.

claims.claim: The existing RelaunchNotification policy supports Windows version 77 and later.
claims.quote: Windows: ≥ 77

claims.claim: The existing RelaunchNotification policy supports macOS version 77 and later.
claims.quote: macOS: ≥ 77

claims.claim: The RelaunchNotification policy does not support Android.
claims.quote: Android: Not supported

claims.claim: The RelaunchNotification policy does not support iOS.
claims.quote: iOS: Not supported

claims.claim: When RelaunchNotification is not configured, Edge adds a recycle icon at the far right of the top menu bar to prompt a restart.
claims.quote: If you don't configure this policy, Microsoft Edge adds a recycle icon at the far right of the top menu bar to prompt users to restart the browser to apply the update.

claims.claim: Recommended produces a recurring warning recommending a restart.
claims.quote: If you enable this policy and set it to 'Recommended', a recurring warning prompts users that a restart is recommended.

claims.claim: Users can dismiss a Recommended warning and defer the restart.
claims.quote: Users can dismiss this warning and defer the restart.

claims.claim: Required produces a recurring warning about the impending automatic restart.
claims.quote: If you set the policy to 'Required', a recurring warning prompts users that the browser will be restarted automatically as soon as a notification period passes.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The existing Required setting already restarts the browser automatically after the notification period.
claims.quote: If you set the policy to 'Required', a recurring warning prompts users that the browser will be restarted automatically as soon as a notification period passes.

claims.claim: The existing RelaunchNotification notification period defaults to seven days.
claims.quote: The default period is seven days.

claims.claim: RelaunchNotificationPeriod configures the existing RelaunchNotification notification period.
claims.quote: You can configure this period with the RelaunchNotificationPeriod policy.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The existing RelaunchNotification reference says the user's session is restored when the browser restarts.
claims.quote: The user's session is restored when the browser restarts.

claims.claim: Group Policy exposes RelaunchNotificationPeriod under (Computer Configuration or User Configuration) > Policies > Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Relaunch > Set the time period for update notifications.
claims.quote:
GP name: Set the time period for update notifications
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Relaunch

claims.claim: RelaunchNotificationPeriod is a REG_DWORD registry value under SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, expressed in milliseconds.
claims.quote:
Allows you to set the time period, in milliseconds
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: RelaunchNotificationPeriod
Value type: REG\_DWORD

claims.claim: RelaunchNotificationPeriod sets the length of time over which users are notified to relaunch Edge for a pending update.
claims.quote: Allows you to set the time period, in milliseconds, over which users are notified that Microsoft Edge must be relaunched to apply a pending update.

claims.claim: RelaunchNotificationPeriod defaults to one week when unset.
claims.quote: If not set, the default period of 604800000 milliseconds (one week) is used.

claims.claim: RelaunchNotificationPeriod applies to the users or computers targeted by the deployed policy.
claims.quote: You can scope policy settings to either the Computer Configuration or User Configuration by selecting the appropriate node as described below.

claims.claim: The RelaunchNotification reference does not yet document the idle-restart extension's UI or automation control.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge idle restarts RelaunchNotification idle update policy default version; opened RelaunchNotification and monitoring dashboard. The reference has no idle option; the dashboard documents a separate management-service action, not this policy extension.

claims.claim: The definition of an idle restart for the roadmap's RelaunchNotification extension is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Edge" "idle restarts" "version"; opened RelaunchNotification and monitoring dashboard. The dashboard describes its own Force auto restart action; neither page defines the roadmap's RelaunchNotification extension.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented how idleness is measured for this RelaunchNotification policy extension.
claims.quote: Searched: "Edge" "idle" "restart" "RelaunchNotification"; opened RelaunchNotification and monitoring dashboard. The latter's 20-minute definition is for a separate management-service action, with no stated connection to this policy extension.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions

claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Edge idle restarts RelaunchNotification idle update policy default version; opened RelaunchNotification, RelaunchFastIfOutdated and monitoring dashboard. No source specifies an idle-restart value for RelaunchNotification.
